intent: PRIMARY function-health gate: no NEW function with cyclomatic complexity over 12 (1 + decision points + &&/||). The less-arbitrary signal than length — flags BRANCHY hard-to-test functions, not merely long ones (McCabe ~10; 12 is forgiving). Ratchet grandfathers today's complex functions and blocks any new one. (Scans only git-non-ignored .ts; the vendored calibrators/family-c.ts is fixed upstream.)
Coarse BACKSTOP: no NEW function over 150 lines (huge-but-flat functions only; complexity above is the primary gate). Ratchet.

No test pinned to a frozen git ref/SHA (git diff <ref>..HEAD, --name-only, git show <sha>). Such tests can only rot once HEAD moves past the round — enforce scope via scripts/anti-scope-gate.sh during the round, not as a permanent product test.

Product tests must not read Anchor process state (coordination/). coordination/ is the pipeline's local working dir; product tests depend only on src/ + fixtures + coverage-matrices/. (Comment citations are fine — only code references count.)
